note: Independent pilot skeletons P01-P10 (proposal 9.1). Not used in confirmatory analysis; the scorer freezes having seen only these. Foreign sentences drafted by the item session on 2026-09-28: zh to be checked by the author, ja/es by back-translation and a bilingual spot check. ja/zh readings are per line, words separated by spaces. Gold translations are hidden from models.

scene.location: The stage door of a concert venue in Night City
scene.speaker: A delivery driver
scene.e_inaud_description: A delivery driver shouts to Kerry from across a wide, roaring street; the traffic drowns it out and Kerry cannot hear a word.

skeleton_en: I left the {OBJECT} over by the {PLACE}. Go get it before dawn.

questions.task: So what are we picking up, and where?
